blind.second_guess: flight of stone stairs with side niche
blind.description: A solid, straight flight of dressed stone stairs rising to a top landing. The structure has a solid stone masonry flank beneath the steps, featuring a small arched decorative niche or recessed alcove on one side. The individual steps are chiseled stone slabs with beveled edges and faint mossy green weathering in the crevices. The stonework is composed of warm grey-brown rectangular ashlar blocks.
blind.from_above: A rectangular plan showing a sequence of straight step treads ascending from one end to a wider flat landing at the opposite end, divided into regular parallel stone blocks.
blind.height_vs_figure: The top landing is roughly 1.1 to 1.2 times the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (about 6.5 to 7 feet tall), and the staircase base is roughly 1.5 times the figure's height in length (about 8.5 to 9 feet long).
